name: Colonel Ironwhisker
attackHints: Step across the locked bayonet lane.
Hold your counter until the return charge ends in phases two and three.
Stay outside the rifle cone for both volleys.
In the breach drill, clear the short sweep and the longer thrust.

name: Major Bramble
attackHints: The sniper takes two shots down the same sightline.
When the camouflage shifts, watch the marked landing and the shot from the second nest.
Step out early on the final, faster double tap.
Leave the marked snare before the sniper round follows.

name: General Flintfang
attackHints: Quarry shells land on marked stakes. Leave both circles in later phases.
Step back from the core impact, then close inside the outer shockwave.
The walking barrage marches through three circles in order.

name: Marshal Whiteclaw
attackHints: Cross the skate track, then move out of the following ice fan.
Leave the frost patch until the last pulse. A hit chills the fighter.
The last bloom strikes three times.
The split glacier leaves a central gap, then fires straight through it.

name: Field Marshal Sirocco
attackHints: Read both sections of the switchback before crossing.
Sandglass rockets stagger along two marked points.
Counter when the second dash stops.
The mirage cut begins at a new flank. Watch the track from its landing.

name: Admiral Miretooth
attackHints: The poison broadside hits port and starboard before the center.
Step clear of the purge cone and its follow-up drain.
The ebb tide sweeps the outer fan first. Move out before the inner fan fills.

name: Director Geargnash
attackHints: Hit the exposed igniter during the windup to defuse every mine.
The furnace vent has a hollow center. Leave it before the core flares.
Destroy the dynamo to cancel both beams, or stand outside their lane.

name: Supreme Commander Vex
attackHints: The open wedge in the encirclement is safe. Keep moving past the next mark.
The firing order locks a double volley and then a shell. Counter after the shell.
Interrupt the execution order by hitting Vex, or take cover from each linked rifle.

name: Adolph Whisker
attackHints: Command duel · cross the locked dash or double volley, then counter.
Signal network · shoot the relay to interrupt the broken ring. Its open wedge is safe.
False retreat · leave the marked landing and deal with the signal escort.
Last stand · anticipate the double shot and the following landing, then attack together.
